title: Find DD's live dataDir and query index.sqlite directly
trigger: Need to verify which .dd-data dir the running DD MCP server is using, or need to inspect index.sqlite (e.g. retrieval_events, health indicators) directly instead of trusting a cached/derived value.
behavior_delta: 1) dataDir is not in .dd/ui.json or mcp__dd__status output. Find the live node process via `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"` (or ps) and look for `node mcp.js` — then cross-check its resolution against src/project.js: dataDir = $env:DD_DATA or join(GROK_PLUGIN_DATA/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA or ~/.dd-data, `${slug}-${identity}`), where identity = sha256(resolve(repoRoot)).slice(0,12). 2) sqlite3 CLI is not installed in this environment — use `node -e "require('node:sqlite').DatabaseSync"` (Node >=22 built-in, experimental) to open index.sqlite and query tables directly (table is `memory_retrieval_events`, not `retrieval_events`).
what: 1) dataDir is not in .dd/ui.json or mcp__dd__status output. Find the live node process via `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'"` (or ps) and look for `node mcp.js` — then cross-check its resolution against src/project.js: dataDir = $env:DD_DATA or join(GROK_PLUGIN_DATA/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA or ~/.dd-data, `${slug}-${identity}`), where identity = sha256(resolve(repoRoot)).slice(0,12). 2) sqlite3 CLI is not installed in this environment — use `node -e "require('node:sqlite').DatabaseSync"` (Node >=22 built-in, experimental) to open index.sqlite and query tables directly (table is `memory_retrieval_events`, not `retrieval_events`).
why: Verified end-to-end while confirming a restart: dataDir resolved to ~/.dd-data/supermem-3892c3ad040f (timestamp matched restart), and cap_saturation's reported value:0/status:healthy was cross-checked by querying memory_retrieval_events directly since `sqlite3` CLI was unavailable (`sqlite3: command not found`).

evidence_refs.summary: openStore()/findRepoRoot() show dataDir resolution: ~/.dd-data/<slug>-<sha256(repoRoot)[:12]> unless DD_DATA/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/GROK_PLUGIN_DATA set.
Found live process `node mcp.js` (pid 48908) confirming which server instance was running post-restart.
sqlite3 CLI missing on this machine; node:sqlite DatabaseSync worked to list tables and count memory_retrieval_events (80 rows) directly from index.sqlite.

legacy_reason: The live data directory is no longer found by inspecting a `node mcp.js` process: one resident (node src/cli.js ui) serves every project, and projectDataDir() names each project's directory from normalizePath(repoRoot), not resolve(repoRoot).
